description: OnRecord statutory clock & redaction auditor — Audits an agency's public-records response and leads with a decision (late, redaction problems, incomplete, pending or no violation found). Computes the statutory response deadline and days late (California CPRA, with the court-day calendar and § 7922.535 extension rules), flags redactions without an exemption citation, passages redacted in one document but readable in another, referenced attachme

agencyName.description: Agency that received the request; fills the follow-up letter.

asOfDate.description: Observation date when responseDate is omitted; defaults to today (UTC).

expectedDate.description: Date the agency says its determination will be dispatched.

noticeSource.description: Identifier of the written notice (letter, portal message). Empty makes the extension defective.

reason.description: One of SEPARATE_FIELD_FACILITIES, VOLUMINOUS_RECORDS, INTERAGENCY_CONSULTATION, DATA_COMPILATION, CYBERATTACK_SYSTEMS_UNAVAILABLE, DECLARED_EMERGENCY_OPERATIONAL_IMPACT.

gapThresholdDays.description: Report gaps between dated events longer than this (default 30).

jurisdiction.description: OnRecord jurisdiction code. Only "CA_CPRA" (alias "US-CA") has a statute table; any other value returns clock "unknown_jurisdiction" while document checks still run.

requestDate.description: Date the agency received the request (YYYY-MM-DD or RFC 3339; read in the offset written).

requestReference.description: The agency's request or tracking number, for the follow-up letter.

requesterName.description: Your name, for the follow-up letter signature.

responseDate.description: Date of the agency's determination/response. Omit if none yet.

name: audit-public-record
